messages:
Devon: Quick alignment postmortem  owners + 10-day action plan for streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partials, reconnects).
Anya: Keep it terse: owner, target date, 1 metric.
Devon: Agreed. Three tracks: reconnect/backoff, partial-detect+resume, telemetry + canary safety.
Matt: I'll own reconnect/backoff. Plan: small client lib (jittered exponential), server hint to reject stale resumes, staging validation.
Lia: I'll own partial detection and safe-resume. Building an e2e harness to replay chunks and force mid-stream socket close.
incident-bot: created INC-5050 "streaming resiliency sprint" https://tracker/redwood/INC-5050
Matt: Compact timeline:
- day 0-2: client lib + server handshake flag
- day 3-4: staging matrix (success/latency)
- day 5: 10% canary
- day 6-9: ramp to 100% if green
Anya: Acceptance (one-liners): reconnect success >= 99.5% within 30s; partials down >= 90%; token-latency regression <= 5%.
Lia: Add metrics: resume_attempts, resume_success, duplicate_resume_count. Resume flow must be idempotent.
Devon: SRE to provide canary runbook + automatic rollback criteria. Suggested rollback: streaming error rate > 0.5% for 5m OR token-latency > 2x baseline for 3m.
SRE-Bot: runbook uploaded to INC-5050; rollback triggers configured.
Anya: Telemetry tasks: alert when partial_chunk_rate > 0.1% over 5m; dashboard per-route resume latency; add trace sampling on resume failures.
Devon: Note: recurring spikes seen ~03:00 UTC on low-load hosts. Hypothesis: node TCP keepalive mismatch. Infra to test aggressive keepalive on canary pool.
Matt: Backoff pseudo to upstream:
``
const backoffMs = (attempt) => Math.min(9000, 180 * 2**attempt + Math.random()*120);
await sleep(backoffMs(attempt));
``
Lia: Harness ETA 4 days. Will attach repro steps and logs to INC-5050.
Matt: PR target day 3, will ping @Anya and @Devon for review.
Anya: I'll own QA sign-off and coordinate synthetic job that opens streams and force-closes sockets every 10s to detect regressions.
Devon: Owners & targets:
- Matt: reconnect/backoff + canary  due 2026-04-06
- Lia: partial-detect harness + resume  due 2026-04-04
- Anya: telemetry + QA canary checklist  due 2026-04-08
- SRE: canary runbook + rollback  done
Devon: Sync cadence: 20m weekly check-ins on Mondays starting 2026-03-30. Post one-line status here: "ok/blocker/done".
Anya: ack. will post staging numbers next Monday.
Matt: ack. will drop PR link here when ready.
Lia: ack. starting harness now.
Devon: If blocked, tag #eng-oncall and drop a quick note here.
SRE-Bot: reminder: canary channel #release-canary for rollouts]
